summary: Academia Reorder Feature - Complete testing of category and subcategory reordering in Support/Academia module. Fixed critical backend bug (route order issue) and verified all frontend functionality. Backend: 10/10 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows verified.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/academia/categories returns categories with sort_order
Backend: PUT /api/academia/categories/reorder swaps category order correctly
Backend: PUT /api/academia/categories/reorder handles invalid IDs gracefully
Backend: PUT /api/academia/categories/reorder handles empty list
Backend: GET /api/academia/categories returns subcategories with sort_order
Backend: PUT /api/academia/subcategories/reorder swaps subcategory order correctly
Backend: PUT /api/academia/subcategories/reorder handles invalid IDs gracefully
Backend: PUT /api/academia/subcategories/reorder handles empty list
Backend: Reorder preserves video counts
Backend: Reorder preserves subcategory structure
Frontend: Login as support admin (spencer3009@gmail.com) works
Frontend: Navigate to /support/academia loads Academia page
Frontend: Categories panel (data-testid='categories-panel') visible
Frontend: Reorder button (data-testid='enter-reorder-btn') visible in sidebar header
Frontend: Normal mode shows categories without drag handles or arrows
Frontend: Click reorder button enters reorder mode
Frontend: Reorder mode shows 'Arrastra o usa flechas para reordenar' hint
Frontend: Drag handles (GripVertical icons) appear on all categories
Frontend: Up/down arrow buttons appear on each category
Frontend: First category's up arrow is disabled
Frontend: Last category's down arrow is disabled
Frontend: Click down arrow moves category down in list
Frontend: Click up arrow moves category up in list
Frontend: Subcategories shown expanded with drag handles and arrows
Frontend: Subcategory reordering works within parent category
Frontend: 'Guardar orden' button (data-testid='save-reorder-btn') appears at bottom
Frontend: Click 'Guardar orden' shows success toast 'Orden guardado'
Frontend: Save button changes to 'Orden guardado' with checkmark after save
Frontend: Click X button (data-testid='exit-reorder-btn') exits reorder mode
Frontend: Sidebar returns to normal mode after exit
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend route order issue - /academia/categories/reorder was being matched by /academia/categories/{cat_id} because parameterized route was defined first. Moved reorder routes BEFORE parameterized routes.
Frontend SupportAcademiaPage.jsx correctly implements reorder mode with state: reorderMode, reorderCats, reorderSaving, reorderSaved, expandedReorderCats, dragState, dropTarget
Drag & drop uses HTML5 native API with onDragStart, onDragOver, onDrop, onDragEnd handlers
Arrow buttons provide alternative reordering method with moveCatInReorder and moveSubInReorder functions
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing categories and subcategories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Academia reorder feature fully tested. Categories and subcategories can be reordered using drag & drop or arrow buttons. Backend routes fixed - reorder routes must be defined BEFORE parameterized routes to avoid route matching issues. All data-testid attributes verified: enter-reorder-btn, exit-reorder-btn, save-reorder-btn, cat-up-{id}, cat-down-{id}, sub-up-{id}, sub-down-{id}, reorder-cat-{id}, reorder-sub-{id}.

bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI route order issue - /academia/categories/{cat_id} was defined before /academia/categories/reorder, so {cat_id} parameter was capturing 'reorder' as the category ID
bug_fixed.fix: Moved @router.put('/academia/categories/reorder') BEFORE @router.put('/academia/categories/{cat_id}') in academia.py. Same fix applied for subcategories reorder route.

verified_features.drag_handles: GripVertical icons on left of each category/subcategory
verified_features.arrow_buttons: ChevronUp/ChevronDown on right of each category/subcategory
verified_features.save_button: Sticky at bottom, shows 'Guardar orden' -> 'Orden guardado' after save
verified_features.exit_button: X button in sidebar header to exit reorder mode
verified_features.subcategories_expanded: All categories expand to show subcategories in reorder mode
